summary: Sabesp filed a Form 6-K reporting that its Extraordinary General Meeting approved a 1:5 stock split of common shares, with no change to share capital. Post-split, share capital will be 3,524,534,025 common shares plus one special class preferred share held by the State of São Paulo. Shares trade ex-split as of April 29, 2026, based on an April 28 record date, with new shares credited on April 30 and reflected in positions on May 4. This is a routine capital-structure adjustment, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
